label: Control and governance frameworks
summary: Sets how a voluntary or contract-driven control set is applied: the CSF Tiers and community profile, the 800-53 baseline, the 800-171 revision and CMMC level, the AI RMF lifecycle and AI types, the CIS implementation group or the COBIT design factors, and how often it is reassessed.

source.ref: NIST CSF 2.0 (CSWP 29) and SP 1301: current and target profiles, tiers, community profiles, GOVERN context GV.OC

fields.label: CSF Tiers
fields.note: Tiers are optional and are not a maturity score. Say whether they will be used to describe how rigorous risk governance and risk management are.

fields.label: Community profile
fields.note: A sector or use-case baseline to start from. Leave empty if there is none.

fields.label: Baseline

source.ref: NIST RMF (SP 800-37 Rev 2): prepare, categorize, select; FIPS 199; SP 800-53B baselines; roles crosswalk

fields.note: The control baseline: given by the agency or contract, or chosen from the system's highest FIPS 199 impact level (SP 800-53B).

fields.label: Privacy baseline

source.ref: NIST RMF (SP 800-37 Rev 2): prepare, categorize, select; FIPS 199; SP 800-53B baselines; roles crosswalk

fields.note: Add the privacy baseline when the system processes personal information, whatever the security level.

fields.label: CMMC level

source.ref: NIST SP 800-171 and 32 CFR part 170 (CMMC): CUI scoping, asset categories, SSP, POA&M, SPRS

fields.note: From the contract. The status can be Conditional or Final.

fields.label: NIST revision

source.ref: NIST withdrew Rev 2 on 14 May 2024; the DoD still assessed against Rev 2 by class deviation (secondary, unverified)

fields.note: The revision the contract or CMMC assessment uses. Check the contract: NIST withdrew Rev 2 in 2024 but the Department of Defense may still assess against it (unverified).

fields.label: Handles CUI

source.ref: NIST SP 800-171 and 32 CFR part 170 (CMMC): CUI scoping, asset categories, SSP, POA&M, SPRS

fields.note: Whether controlled unclassified information is handled now or expected under a contract. A contract clause or a marking shows it.

fields.label: SPRS status

source.ref: NIST SP 800-171 and 32 CFR part 170 (CMMC): CUI scoping, asset categories, SSP, POA&M, SPRS

fields.note: Whether a Basic Assessment score has been posted to SPRS. The score itself is not needed here.

fields.label: Implementation group
fields.note: Each group includes the one before. Everyone starts with IG1; IG2 suits dedicated IT staff and sensitive client data; IG3 suits specialists, regulated or targeted organisations.

source.ref: Assessment practice: a Current and a Target Profile (NIST CSF), a system security plan and a plan of action (NIST SP 800-53, 800-171), an AI risk process (AI RMF) and a capability assessment (COBIT) are what an assessor asks whether they exist. Only their existence is asked here.

fields.label: Current Profile
fields.note: Whether a Current Profile (where the organisation stands now) already exists.

fields.label: Profile file
fields.note: Optional: attach the Current Profile. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Target Profile
fields.note: Whether a Target Profile (the outcomes the organisation aims for) already exists.

fields.label: Target file
fields.note: Optional: attach the Target Profile. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Federal context
options: Contractor operating a system for an agency
Cloud service offered to federal agencies (FedRAMP)
Not federal, used as a reference
fields.note: Whether the system is a federal one, runs for an agency, is a cloud service sold to agencies, or uses the catalogue as a reference.

fields.label: Authorization

when.ne: Not federal, used as a reference

fields.note: Where the authorization to operate stands, if the system needs one.

fields.label: Security plan
fields.note: Whether a system security plan already exists. Only its existence is asked.

fields.label: Plan file
fields.note: Optional: attach the system security plan. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Earlier assessment
fields.note: Whether the controls were assessed before (SP 800-53A or an equivalent).

fields.label: Assessment file
fields.note: Optional: attach the assessment report. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Security plan
fields.note: Whether a system security plan for the CUI environment already exists.

fields.label: Plan file
fields.note: Optional: attach the system security plan. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Plan of action
fields.note: Whether a plan of action and milestones (POA&M) for unmet requirements already exists.

fields.label: POA&M file
fields.note: Optional: attach the plan of action. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: CUI systems
fields.note: The systems that store, process or transmit controlled unclassified information, picked from the asset inventory.

fields.label: AI actor role
fields.note: The parts the organisation plays in AI systems; none ticked means it only buys third-party AI. It tells which AI RMF categories matter most.

fields.label: Generative AI
fields.note: Whether generative AI is used. It decides whether the Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1) applies as well.

fields.label: AI systems
fields.note: The AI systems in scope, picked from the asset inventory. Leave empty if the inventory does not hold them yet.

fields.label: AI risk process
fields.note: Whether a process for assessing AI risk already exists. Only its existence is asked.

fields.label: Process document
fields.note: Optional: attach the AI risk process. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: CIS Benchmarks
fields.note: Whether the CIS Benchmarks (secure configuration guides) are already used to harden systems.

fields.label: Earlier assessment
fields.note: Whether the safeguards were assessed before, with CIS CSAT or another tool.

fields.label: Assessment file
fields.note: Optional: attach the assessment result. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Objectives in scope
fields.note: Whether all 40 COBIT governance and management objectives apply, or a selection.

fields.label: Design factors
fields.note: Whether the governance system design exercise (design factors) was already done.

fields.label: Design file
fields.note: Optional: attach the design exercise result. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Capability assessment
fields.note: Whether process capability levels were assessed before.

fields.label: Assessment file
fields.note: Optional: attach the capability assessment. It is kept in Evidence.

fields.label: Rating scale

source.ref: SP 1301 steps 3 to 5 (create, analyse gaps, implement); CIS CSAT; COBIT phases 2 to 7

fields.note: Scale for current and target ratings and for priority. Fix it before rating.

fields.label: Assessment tool

source.ref: SP 1301 steps 3 to 5 (create, analyse gaps, implement); CIS CSAT; COBIT phases 2 to 7

fields.note: How safeguards will be rated.

fields.label: Review cycle

source.ref: SP 1301 steps 3 to 5 (create, analyse gaps, implement); CIS CSAT; COBIT phases 2 to 7

fields.note: How often the assessment is repeated. The frameworks fix no cycle; regulators and customers often do.
